metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises to help relieve anal pain caused by strain in the pelvic floor muscles.

Each exercise works differently and targets different muscles. For the best results, try them all and continue with the ones that bring you the most relief.

Watch now and start relieving anal pain at home!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:43 Knee Rocker
2:17 Child's Pose with Pillow
3:46 Legs-up-the-wall
5:41 Seated March
7:32 Kegel Bridge (Strengthening)
